theme: 3 terms for animated drawing in SwiftUI: a scheduled view, a one-image render and the drawing tool of a Canvas

terms.definition: A view that updates its content on a schedule, such as every second.
terms.example: Wrap the clock in a TimelineView, so it ticks every second.

terms.definition: A modifier that draws a view and its children as one image with Metal, so complex drawing is faster.
terms.example: Add Drawing Group, because the particles are slow.

terms.definition: The drawing tool inside a Canvas that you use to fill shapes, strokes and text.
terms.example: Call fill on the GraphicsContext to draw the face.

video.title: TimelineView, Drawing Group & GraphicsContext | Day 159
video.description:
Learn to explain how to draw animated graphics in SwiftUI: TimelineView, Drawing Group & GraphicsContext, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
TimelineView - A view that updates its content on a schedule, such as every second.
Drawing Group - A modifier that draws a view and its children as one image with Metal, so complex drawing is faster.
GraphicsContext - The drawing tool inside a Canvas that you use to fill shapes, strokes and text.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Can you explain TimelineView, Drawing Group and GraphicsContext in English?

dialogue.title: The clock face

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I draw a clock face with a Canvas, but it never changes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Canvas draws once. Wrap it in a TimelineView, and it updates on a schedule.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. That schedule updates the TimelineView on every frame.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now, how do I draw inside the Canvas?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: With the GraphicsContext. It is the drawing tool that fills shapes, strokes and text.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it the `context` in the closure?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Call `fill` on the GraphicsContext with a Path and a color.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My animation is slow when I draw thousands of shapes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add Drawing Group. It draws the view as one image with Metal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does Drawing Group change how it looks?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sometimes, with blur and shadows. Test it on a real device.
A TimelineView redraws the clock every second.
